decision: For each case, return exactly one verdict and an exact substring quote from the input.
requirements: quote must be a non-empty exact substring of case.text
reject only when the stated structured-prose defect is present
preserve when no targeted defect is present
abstain when evidence is insufficient; never invent evidence
never discuss authorship, AI generation, or whether text was written by a person or model

score.order: failures and false positives are penalized before recall
score.failure: missing, malformed, fabricated-quote, authorship, or false-confirm output is a measured failure
